project_type: Python FastAPI EDMS with Jinja2 templates, Tailwind CSS CDN, htmx
test_framework: pytest-asyncio with SQLite in-memory, httpx AsyncClient, tests/conftest.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -x -q' - all tests must pass (baseline: 620). 2. Run 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' - no lint errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11.14 available via uv.
contribution_requirements: Models inherit from Base in app/models/group.py. API routes use APIRouter registered in app/api/router.py. Auth uses get_current_user/require_role/require_permission from app/core/security.py. Templates extend app/templates/base.html using Jinja2 + Tailwind CDN + htmx.

key_patterns.models: Inherit from Base (app/models/group.py), use mapped_column with SQLAlchemy 2.0 style, UUIDs for user-related PKs, integers for document/group PKs
key_patterns.api_routes: Use APIRouter with prefix and tags, registered in app/api/router.py. Depend on get_db, get_current_user, etc.
key_patterns.services: Business logic in app/services/, instantiated at module level in API files
key_patterns.templates: Jinja2 in app/templates/, extend base.html, use Tailwind CSS CDN + htmx 1.9.10
key_patterns.pages: HTML page routes in app/api/pages.py using Jinja2Templates
key_patterns.tests: pytest-asyncio, fixtures in tests/conftest.py (db_session, client, sample_pdf), tests use AsyncClient with ASGI transport
key_patterns.auth: JWT Bearer token in localStorage, authFetch() helper in templates for JS API calls
key_patterns.websocket: Notifications via /ws/notifications with JWT auth via query param
key_patterns.pipeline: app/services/pipeline.py processes docs: convert, summarize, extract keywords, chunk, embed, wiki ingest, preview

directory_structure: app/ (main app): api/ (routes), core/ (config, db, security, llm), models/ (SQLAlchemy), schemas/ (Pydantic), services/ (business logic), templates/ (Jinja2 HTML), middleware/. tests/ (pytest). storage/ (uploaded files). wiki/ (LLM wiki). chroma_db/ (vector store).
